clues: This town sits on the west shore, in the south of its state. It lies right at the line with Mexico.
In late spring, a thick sea cloud hugs this coast and keeps it cool and damp. A few miles inland, that same day is bright and hot.
In 1769, men from Spain built a fort and a mission on this coast. It was the first town Europeans built in what is now California.
This city has an airport with just one runway. Yet it is the busiest airport of its kind in the whole United States.
Just south of town is the most busy land gate in the world, the gate to Mexico.
